title: Skip Allowance and Skip Cut-Off Reference — Auto Refill & Medication Sync
content:
Under Auto Refill & Medication Sync each program sets how many cycles may be skipped in a program year, how many may be skipped in a row, and how many hours before processing a scheduled cycle can still be skipped.

| Program | Cycles that may be skipped per program year | Most cycles in a row that may be skipped | Hours before processing up to which a scheduled cycle may be skipped |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day | 3 | 2 | 24 |
| Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day | 2 | 1 | 24 |
| Kestrel Med Sync Monthly | 3 | 2 | 48 |
| Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day | 2 | 1 | 48 |
| Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging | 2 | 1 | 72 |
| Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill | 2 | 1 | 48 |

## Reading the reference

- The yearly allowance and the in-a-row limit are whole numbers of cycles; the cut-off is a whole number of hours counted back from the time the cycle is processed.
- The two monthly-supply programs without packaging (Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day and Kestrel Med Sync Monthly) allow 3 skips a year and 2 in a row; every other program allows 2 a year and 1 in a row.
- The cut-off is 24 hours for Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day and Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day, 48 hours for Kestrel Med Sync Monthly, Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day and Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill, and 72 hours for Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging.
